federation.title: 格鲁吉亚马术联合会
federation.subtitle: 赛事支持与组织团队
bullets: Provided direct support to multi-time Georgian Champion and 2-time World Cup Qualifier **Shalva GACHECHILADZE**.
Served as an official Jump Crew member across all federation competitions.
Managed full-scale venue setup and live event execution for all events.
Built Official [Georgian Equestrian Federation](https://www.georgianequestrianfederation.ge/) website, managing real-time competition data and official results for every event.
Developed an interactive show jumping [Course Memory Game](https://equestiran-course-game.web.app/) challenging players to memorize obstacle sequences and accurately trace the exact route on-screen.

courseDesigner.title: FEI 路线设计师合作经历
courseDesigner.subtitle: 与国际路线设计师合作
bullets: Assisted **Ivo MIKELSONS** (FEI Course Designer Level 3) at multiple annual World Cup Qualifiers.
Worked with **Olaf PETERSEN** (FEI Course Designer Level 4) on technical course layouts and track adjustments.
Executed full arena setups from technical blueprints, ensuring precise distance measurements and obstacle positioning per FEI standards.
Coordinated on-arena logistics, electronic timing placement, and dynamic course modifications between competition rounds.

steward.title: FEI 赛事管理官
steward.subtitle: 赛事官方 Steward
bullets: Participated in international and national competitions as an official FEI Level 1 Steward.
Ensured strict adherence to animal welfare standards and fair play under Chief Steward **Jan POSLUSZNY** (FEI Jumping Steward Level 3).
Supervised and prepared warm-up arenas in accordance with official FEI standards and regulations.
Conducted mandatory boot checks, saddlery, and equipment inspections to safeguard equine welfare.

riding.title: 骑术与马匹护理
riding.subtitle: 骑手与马匹经验
bullets: Experienced rider focused on exercising, schooling, and conditioning horses for daily fitness and athletic development.
Perform all aspects of daily horse handling, from grooming and tacking to post-workout care.
Apply practical knowledge of equine behavior to ensure safe and stress-free handling in any environment.
